paragraphs.source_en: This was no longer the Furuwatari Castle of old. Shiba Yoshimune was dead, and Hiko Gorō, head of the main Oda house, had also perished. Nobunaga had moved into Kiyosu Castle and united Owari through his own strength. Nōhime had always supported Nobunaga from behind the scenes as he pursued his great ambitions. More than his brilliant military mind, Nōhime found Nobunaga's gift for governing truly extraordinary, and there had been times when she could not help losing herself in happiness.

units.source_en: This was no longer the Furuwatari Castle of old.

paragraphs.source_zh: 这已经不是以前的古渡城。斯波义统已去世，织田氏的宗家彦五郎也灭亡了，信长移住清洲城，依靠自己的实力完成了尾张的统一。浓姬一直在背后支持着信长完成霸业。较之卓越的军事头脑，浓姬觉得信长的治国之才更加非同寻常，她曾情不自禁地陶醉在幸福之中。

paragraphs.source_en: It was precisely because she had trusted and relied upon her father so deeply that the blow Nōhime now suffered was all the greater. Her father's life had been like a dream; all his work in Mino and all her mother's efforts had come to nothing. Nōhime had lost not only both her parents; all her hope and strength had vanished as well. Although reason told her that Nobunaga's future strategies and actions would be bolder and more flawless than ever, she could not say why she kept feeling that before long, all those efforts too would dissolve into a dream…

paragraphs.source_en: “My lady.” The old nurse slipped quietly into the room and called to her in a low voice. Sorrowfully, Nōhime raised her tear-streaked face and forced a faint smile. Nōhime, who never allowed others to see her weakness, felt her whole body turn cold when she saw the panic in the old nurse's eyes.

paragraphs.source_zh: “夫人。”老嬷嬷悄悄走了进来，小声叫道。浓姬忧伤地抬起涕泪纵横的脸，勉强笑了笑。任何时候都不让外人看见自己软弱一面的浓姬，看到老嬷嬷那惊惶失措的眼神时，不禁全身冰凉。

paragraphs.source_en: “In the Buddhist chapel,” the old nurse gasped, “Lady Okatsu has taken her own life.”

paragraphs.source_en: The sky was gradually darkening. If it rained, it would surely be the welcome rain of the fifth month. But Nōhime wished the sky would clear, if only for a little while.

paragraphs.source_en: “Look—” the old nurse said in a somber voice, pressing her palms together.

paragraphs.source_en: Nōhime looked at Okatsu, who lay collapsed face-down upon the tatami. She had not yet breathed her last, and the dagger lodged in her breast was still trembling. Yet there was no trace of pain on her face; rather, she seemed to have grown peaceful after at last finding the place where she belonged. “Okatsu…” Nōhime murmured mournfully.

paragraphs.source_en: A sudden, overwhelming anger seized Nōhime, and she placed a hand on Okatsu's shoulder. “You are not the one burdened with grievous sin! What sin have you committed?”

paragraphs.source_en: But Okatsu could no longer hear Nōhime's words. What was Okatsu's soul gazing upon? What had it encountered? Once more she whispered, “Forgive me…” Then her lips closed.

paragraphs.source_en: Nōhime looked at the maid of Lady Iwamuro, the last beloved concubine of Nobunaga's father, then turned and urged the old nurse, “Bring Lady Iwamuro here.”

paragraphs.source_en: Okatsu, Lady Iwamuro, and Nōhime were close in age. Yet of the three, one had gone to heaven, one had shaved her head and become a nun, and only she herself remained… A sudden impulse seized Nōhime: she wanted to cry out against this unfathomable world, to curse it aloud.

units.source_en: Yet of the three, one had gone to heaven, one had shaved her head and become a nun, and only she herself remained… A sudden impulse seized Nōhime: she wanted to cry out against this unfathomable world, to curse it aloud.
units.source_zh: 而这三个人中，一个已经归天，一个削发为尼，只剩自己……浓姬忽然有一种冲动，她想对着这难以捉摸的世道大声呼喊，想诅咒这个世道。

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿胜、岩室夫人和浓姬年龄相仿。而这三个人中，一个已经归天，一个削发为尼，只剩自己……浓姬忽然有一种冲动，她想对着这难以捉摸的世道大声呼喊，想诅咒这个世道。

paragraphs.source_en: The old nurse had already lit incense and candles beside Okatsu's pillow. Okatsu's spirit seemed to be riding the pale-blue incense smoke, drifting slowly upward into the air. Nōhime thought of chanting the Buddha's name to guide her soul onward, but abandoned the thought. This soul… how could it ever be delivered?
